name: ospf
description: 3 routers in a triangle with OSPF, 2 hosts on separate routers

frr_configs.r1:
!
interface r1-r2 
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
!
interface r1-r3
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
!
interface r1-h1
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
!
interface lo
 ip ospf area 0
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.0.0.1
 network 10.0.0.1/32 area 0
 network 10.1.12.0/30 area 0
 network 10.1.13.0/30 area 0
 network 192.168.1.0/24 area 0
!
frr_configs.r2:
!
interface r2-r1
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
!
interface r2-r3
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
!
interface lo
 ip ospf area 0
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.0.0.2
 network 10.0.0.2/32 area 0
 network 10.1.12.0/30 area 0
 network 10.1.23.0/30 area 0
!
frr_configs.r3:
!
interface r3-r1
 ip ospf area 0

!

 network 10.1.13.0/30 area 0

!
